newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends higher, gains pared in slow day.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends higher, gains pared in slow day.

text.p: COMEX copper settled slightly firmer but with gains pared after late profit-taking in thin, holiday week trading as LME remained closed until Friday.

Some light buying helped to firm up the market which was kept buoyant as there is no LME stock report Friday - the market has closed lower before each report recently because inventories have been rising, Bette Raptopoulos of Prudential Securities said.
"Those who were long also took some profits," she added.
March COMEX settled 0.85 cent firmer at 99.70 cents per pound, traded 101.00 to 98.85 cents. Spot December, which goes off the board Friday, went out 0.50 cent higher at 102.10 cents.
Volume was only an estimated 4,000 lots by 1300 EST, an hour before close.
Both COMEX and LME were closed Wednesday for Christmas Day holiday. LME reopens Friday but there will be no regular stock report until Tuesday.
